# pr-details
Pull requests for the PR details tabs, with bare links like https://example.com/docs/start, http://example.org/a?b=1 and ftp://files.example.net/pub.
Hosts like www.example.com, docs.example.io/guide and the file README.md become links too.
Mail user@example.com or mailto:user@example.com, and see //cdn.example.com/lib.js as well.
Trailing punctuation stays out (https://example.com/end), https://example.com/q? and "https://example.com/quoted".
Not in code `https://example.com/code` or in a [named link](https://example.com/named) to www.example.net.
Emphasis doesn't split http://example.com/*wiki* or *https://example.com/em*, and targets are normalized: https://xn--bcher-kva.example/%C3%A4, www.xn--bcher-kva.de and https://example.com/a[1]|b.

note: Hand-written for the linkify-diff-error scenario: one paragraph of bare URLs, hosts and emails, without blank lines or header-shaped lines, which the Python app drops (Py bug B47). The last line covers #284: a scheme link that swallows emphasis delimiters, and link text and targets normalized as markdown-it's normalizeLinkText and normalizeLink do.
